subject: A real chubby small dog with a grey-and-black sable coat, black mask, tan eyebrow spots, cream chest and belly and upright pointed ears, standing on its hind legs on a beige marble-tiled floor at home, facing the camera. The dog
moves: bounces up and down on its hind legs in time to the beat, front paws paddling in the air, head bobbing forward on every beat.
keeps bouncing on its hind legs, now waving both front paws up and down in rhythm like begging for a treat, head nodding along.
sways its chubby body left and right on its hind legs, front paws pumping against its chest, head bobbing on every beat.
does small quick hops in place on its hind legs, paws paddling, ears bouncing, mouth open and panting happily.
nods its head hard to the beat like a rapper, rocking side to side on its hind legs, front paws waving.
keeps bouncing on its hind legs to the beat, front paws raised, tongue out, looking straight at the camera.
